say:1:1310522001:0.text: These are the graves of the warriors who were lost in the war.
say:1:1310522001:0.source_cn: 原来是那些牺牲在恶魔战争中的战士的墓。

say:2:1310522002:1.text: The flowers here... they have a tragic beauty that surpasses the rest of the Floral Ruins.
say:2:1310522002:1.source_cn: 这里的鲜花……比花海其他地方都多了一份壮烈的美丽……

say:3:1310522003:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I understand now. Let's bury those rusted swords here.
say:3:1310522003:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I understand now. Let's bury those rusted swords here.
say:3:1310522003:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I understand now. Let's bury those rusted swords here.

say:4:1310522004:1.text: These soldiers must want to reunite with their comrades...
say:4:1310522004:1.source_cn: 对呀，那些士兵也一定很想和他们的战友重聚的……
